import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_K = 32;
    
    static long n_val;
    static int k_val;
    
    static boolean readInput() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (scanner.hasNextLong() && scanner.hasNextInt()) {
            n_val = scanner.nextLong();
            k_val = scanner.nextInt();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int addMod(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
        return a;
    }
    
    static int mulMod(int a, int b) {
        return (int) (((long) a * b) % MOD);
    }
    
    static class Matrix {
        int[][] data;
        
        Matrix() {
            data = new int[MAX_K][MAX_K];
        }
        
        Matrix(int[][] d) {
            data = d;
        }
        
        void setIdentity() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_K; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        void setZero() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAX_K; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        Matrix copy() {
            int[][] newData = new int[MAX_K][MAX_K];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_K; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(data[i], 0, newData[i], 0, MAX_K);
            }
            return new Matrix(newData);
        }
    }
    
    static Matrix matMult(Matrix A, Matrix B) {
        Matrix C = new Matrix();
        C.setZero();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k_val; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k_val; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= k_val; t++) {
                    C.data[i][j] = addMod(C.data[i][j], mulMod(A.data[i][t], B.data[t][j]));
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }
    
    static Matrix[][] base = new Matrix[62][MAX_K];
    
    static void solveCase() {
        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        long temp = n_val;
        while (temp > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(temp % k_val));
            temp /= k_val;
        }
        
        // Initialize base matrices
        for (int d = 0; d < k_val; d++) {
            base[0][d] = new Matrix();
            base[0][d].setIdentity();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k_val; i++) {
                base[0][d].data[i][d] = addMod(base[0][d].data[i][d], 1);
            }
        }
        
        // Build higher level base matrices
        for (int lvl = 1; lvl < digits.size(); lvl++) {
            List<Matrix> prefix = new ArrayList<>();
            Matrix identity = new Matrix();
            identity.setIdentity();
            prefix.add(identity);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < k_val; i++) {
                Matrix next = matMult(prefix.get(prefix.size() - 1), base[lvl - 1][i]);
                prefix.add(next);
            }
            
            for (int sh = 0; sh < k_val; sh++) {
                base[lvl][sh] = prefix.get(0).copy();
                for (int i = 0; i < k_val - sh; i++) {
                    base[lvl][sh] = matMult(base[lvl][sh], base[lvl - 1][(i + sh) % k_val]);
                }
                base[lvl][sh] = matMult(base[lvl][sh], prefix.get(sh));
            }
        }
        
        // DP matrix
        Matrix dp = new Matrix();
        dp.setZero();
        dp.data[0][k_val] = 1;
        
        int rem = 0;
        for (int i = digits.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (digits.get(i) > 0) {
                dp = matMult(dp, base[i][rem]);
                rem = (rem + 1) % k_val;
                digits.set(i, digits.get(i) - 1);
            }
        }
        
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k_val; i++) {
            ans = addMod(ans, dp.data[0][i]);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        while (readInput()) {
            solveCase();
        }
    }
}
